instruction: A candid street photograph captures a full-length shot of two men walking on a city sidewalk under green trees during the day. On the left, the white man in the pink shirt (R2) walks forward, holding a clear cup and looking ahead with a gentle smile. On the right, the Black man in the white shirt (R1) walks beside him, also looking forward and smiling. The two men are holding hands as they stroll side-by-side. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight filtering through the leaves, creating gentle shadows on the pavement with a cool color palette.
